reviews.rationale: Operative Permitted Liens (21) ceiling authorizing other Liens up to greater-of amount — true permission.
§6.01(r) 'other Indebtedness ... not exceeding' is an affirmative exception basket.
Explicit 'may make Restricted Payments ... not to exceed $40,000,000' — permission.
Incurrence ratio limb inside §6.01(q) grants residual room — not a maintenance test.
Chapeau grants uncapped debt if FCCR and Payment Conditions satisfied — permission gated by conditions precedent.
'together with' shared ceiling is affirmative shared capacity, not a mere comparator.
§6.08(a)(3) builder defines Available Amount used as RP permission gate — affirmative.
Cross-reference pointer only; Phase-1 correctly did not call this affirmative capacity.

Clause (f) is a builder COMPONENT inside Available Amount, not a standalone permission. Labeling it AFFIRMATIVE_CAPACITY overstates legal permission semantics even though the arithmetic leg is real. Reclassify to INCOMPLETE_SEMANTICS pending builder-context binding.
§1.09 sequences same-day Available Amount actions; it constrains consumption ordering and does not grant capacity.
'without duplication' is a counting constraint bridging investment returns and §7.05(a)(y), not a permission ceiling.
Anti-duplication language for incremental clauses is a netting rule, not affirmative capacity.
Divide-and-classify election governs which basket is used; it is not itself a dollar/ratio capacity grant. Permission arises only after election into a concrete basket.
Same as Chewy reclass — election mechanic, not capacity quantum.
Election mechanic only.
Lien classify/reclassify right without a numeric ceiling in-span.
Classification election among Asset Disposition / Investment categories — not a capacity amount.

Automatic reclass into Incurrence-Based Amounts when ratio later met functionally restores Fixed Amount capacity — capacity-affecting mechanic with operative effect, retain as affirmative with blockers.
Captured span is only 'make Restricted Payments in an unlimited amount;' — the leverage gate lives in surrounding prose not in the span. Cannot affirm unlimited permission from this span alone.
Span truncates mid-sentence before completing even the first ratio limb and omits other priority tiers. Source grounding ≠ complete legal semantics.
Opening fragment of Voluntary Prepayment Incremental Amount; exclusions and eligible debt types continue after span.
Usage election into Available Amount / Available Excluded Contribution Amount without the builder definitions themselves.
Entity-scoped (non-Guarantors) grower is still affirmative capacity for that entity class.
Reinvestment option affects mandatory prepayment capacity — affirmative but narrowly scoped; blockers already note incompleteness of surrounding limbs.
Reduction rule that depletes RP capacity when debt/liens use shared RP capacity — a restriction/netting rule, not a grant of capacity.
Ordinary-course card/banking services debt up to $2mm — true exception permission.
Full Fixed Incremental Amount definition with greater-of starter and shared reallocations — affirmative incremental capacity.
Purchase-money/capex basket with 180-day condition and shared refi sublimit — affirmative.
General lien grower with dual tests (secured obligations AND asset FMV) — affirmative.
Builder leg that both credits returns (replenishment) and forbids double counting — the credit is capacity-affecting; retain affirmative with blockers.
